m: अनुला f. N. of a female Arhat or Buddhist saint
also of a queen of Ceylon.

s: puM, (anu vAraM vAraM lapanaM, anu + lap + BAve GaY .) punaH punaH kaTanaM । punaruktiH । ityamaraH ॥
v: pu॰ anurvIpsAyAM vAraMvAraM lapyate lapa--vaY । muhurBAzaRe ।
m: अनु-लाप m. (√ लप्), repetition of what has been said, tautology.

k.v: अनुलापो मुहुर्भाषा विलापः परिदेवनम्. विप्रलापो विरोधोक्तिः संलापो भाषणं मिथः॥

m: अनु-लास or अनु-लास्य, अस्, m. a peacock.
अनु-√ ली to disappear after, BhP.

a: अनुलीन — a. Hidden, clinging to, attached; Śi. 5. 46; जनादनुलीनः Dk. 104 concealed from the people.

m: अनु-√ लभ् to grasp or take hold of (from behind), ŚBr.; KātyŚr.: Desid. -लिप्सते, to intend to grasp, ib.
अनु-लग्न mfn. attached to
followed
intent on, pursuing after.
a: अनुलग्न — a. Attached to, intent on, seeking or pursuing after; येन आर्यायाः सुस्निग्धा दृष्टिरनुलग्ना Mk. 4 intently fixed.

m: अनु-लक्ष्य ind.p. conforming to.
अनुलम्ब mfn. dependent, subordinate, TāṇḍBr.
अन्-उल्बण mf(आ)n. not excessive, not prominent, keeping the regular measure, RV. &c.

v: pu॰ anu + lipa--BAve GaY । candanAdimarddane । karaRe GaY । anulepasADAne candanAdO ।
m: अनु-लेप m. unction, anointing, bedaubing.
a: अनुलेपः --लेपनं — 1 Unction, anointing, smearing. --2 Ointment, unguent such as sandal juice, oil &c.; any emollient or oily application; ˚आर्द्रमृदंगध्वनि K. 28 rubbed with paste; सुरभि कुसुमधूपानुलेपनानि K. 324.

v: tri॰ anulimpati anu + lipa--Rvul । candanAdiBiH svadehadevArccAdyanulepakArake । striyAM wAp । tasyAH DarmyaM mahizyA॰ aR । Anulepikam tadDarmye tri॰ ।
m: अनु-लेपक mfn. anointing the body with unguents, L.
a: अनुलेपक, --लेपिन् — a. One who anoints (the body) with unguents &c.

s: klI, (anu + lip + BAve lyuw .) pAtre ganDadravyAdilepanaM । taddravyaYca । tasya guRAH । prItyojaHSukravfdDikAritvaM । GarmmadOrganDyatandrAtApaSramanASitvaYca । iti rAjavallaBaH ॥ (“nirastamAlyABaraRAnulepanAH” । iti ftusaMhAre .)
v: na॰ anu + lipa--BAve lyuw । candanAdimardane “DAtrIPalaM taTA dadyAdanulepanakAraRAditi” purA॰ । karaRe lyuw । anulepasADane candanAdO dravye ।
m: अनु-लेपन n. anointing the body
unguent so used
oily or emollient application.
अनु-लेपिका f. (g. महिष्य्-आदि, q.v.)
अनुलेपिन् mfn. (ifc.) smeared or anointed with, MBh.
अनु-√ लिप् P. to anoint, besmear; Ā. to anoint one's self after (bathing) : Caus. -लेपयति, to cause to be anointed.
a: अनुलिप् — {c6c} P. To anoint, besmear (with perfumes &c. after bathing); smear, daub, cover over; वपुरन्वलिप्त न वधूः Śi. 9. 51, 9. 15; प्रभानुलिप्तश्रीवत्सं R. 10. 10 covered with; तच्छायानुलिप्तभूतलां K. 131; हरिभिरचिरभासा तेजसा चानुलिप्तैः Ś. 7. 7; so स्नातानुलिप्तः; तिमिरानुलिप्त enveloped in darkness; स्नापितोऽनुलोपितश्च Dk. 71 besmeared with perfumes &c.

m: अनुलिप्ताङ्ग mfn. having the limbs anointed.

v: tri॰ anu + lipa--kta । ganDAdinA kftAnulepe “vandanAgurukarpUrakuNkumoSIrapatrakEH anulipto narErBaktyA haririzwaM pramacCatIti” purA॰ ।
m: अनु-लिप्त mfn. smeared, anointed.
अनु-लोमा f. a woman of a lower caste than that of the man's with whom she is connected, Yājñ.
अनुलोमार्थ mfn. one who holds favourable views on any question.
अनुलोमाय mfn. having fortune, favourable.

s: puM, (anupUrvvAt lomaSabdAt ac, pratyanvaveti ac .) yaTAkramaM । avilomaH । yaTA, -- “varRamAlA samAKyAtA anulomavilomikA” । iti tantrasAre nAradavacanaM ॥ (kramAnugataH । anukUlaH । “jaqAnapyanulomArTAn pravAcaH kftinAM giraH” । iti SiSupAlabaDe .)
v: pu॰ yaTAkrame avyayI॰ acsamA॰ । yaTAkrame । “anulomavilomAByAM mAtfkArRRAn japedbuDa iti tantra॰ “tatra pratilomamAlimpennAnulomamiti” suSrutam anugataH loma AnurUpyam roma vA prA॰ sa॰ । AnurUpyaprApte, yaTAkramaprApte ca tri॰ “savarRAsu putrAH savarRA Bavanti anulomajA mAtfvarRA” iti vizRusa॰ anulomaM kfzwaM kzetraM pratilolaM karzati si॰ kO॰ । anugatarome ca । “anulomAH sulomASca rucirA romarAjaya” iti ।
m: अनु-लोम mf(आ)n. ‘with the hair or grain’ (opposed to प्रति-लोम, q.v.), in a natural direction, in order, regular, successive
conformable
अनु-लोम m. pl. ‘descendants of an anulomā’, mixed castes, (g. उपकादि, q.v.)
a: अनुलोम — a. [अनुगतः लोम P. V. 4. 75.] 1 ‘With the hair,’ regular, in natural order, successive (opp. प्रतिलोम); (hence), favourable, agreeable; ˚सुखो वायुरनुसारयतीव मां Rām.; त्रिरेनामनुलोमामनुमार्ष्टि Śat. Br.; ˚कृष्टं क्षेत्रं प्रतिलोमं कर्षति Sk. ploughed in the regular direction. --2 Mixed as a tribe. --मा A woman of the lower caste than that of the man's whom she marries; Y. 2. 288. --मं adv. In regular or natural order; प्रतिलोममालिंपेन्नानुलोमं Suśr. --माः (pl.) Mixed castes. --Comp. --अय a. having fortune, favourable. --अर्थ a. speaking in favour of; जडानप्यनुलोमार्थान् प्रवाचः कृतिनां गिरः Śi. 2. 25. --ज, --जन्मन् a. born in due gradation, offspring of a mother inferior in caste to the father; said of the mixed tribes; Ms. 10. 25; Y. 1. 95.

s: tri, (anulomena yaTAkrameRa jAtaH, anuloma + jana + qaH, upapadasamAsaH) । anulomajAtaH । apratilomajaH । yaTA । brAhmaRAt kzattriyAgarBajAtaH । kzattriyAt vESyAyAM jAtaH । ityAdi uttamAdaDamAyAM jAtaH । yaTA, -- “saNkIrRayonayo ye tu pratilomAnulImajAH । anyo'nyavyatizaktASca tAn pravakzyAmyaSezataH” ॥ iti manuH ॥
v: pu॰ strI॰ anulomena yaTAkrameRa jAtaH jana--qa । pariRItakzatriyAdistrIzu viprAdiBya utkfzweByo varReByo jAte mUrdDAvasiktAdO saNkIrRavarRe । anulomajASca “viprAnmUrdDAvasikto hi kzatriyAyAM, viSaHstriyAm । ambazWaH, SUdryAM nizAdajAtiH pAraSavo'pi vA” “vESyASUdryostu rAjanyAt, mAhizyogrO nutO smftO, vESyAttu karaRaH SUdryAM, vinnAsveza viDiH smfta” iti ca yAjYa॰ sa॰ ।
m: अनु-लोम—ज mfn. offspring of a mother inferior in caste to the father [Mn.; Yājñ.], (as the Mūrdhāvasikta of a Brāhman father and Kṣatriyā mother, and so on with the Ambaṣṭha Niṣāda or Pāraśava, Māhiṣya, Ugra, Karaṇa.)

v: pu॰ strI॰ anulomaM pitfvarRAnukrameRa janma yasya । anulomajAte mUrdDAvasiktAdO । striyAM qAp । “anye'nulomajanmAnaH pratilomaBavA apIti” kASI॰ ।

m: अनु-लोम—कल्प m. the thirty-fourth of the Atharva-pariśiṣṭas.
अनु-लोम—कृष्ट mfn. ploughed in the regular direction (with the grain).
अनु-लोमम् ind. in regular order, ŚBr. &c.
अनु-लोमन n. due regulation, sending or putting in the right direction, Suśr.
carrying off by the right channels, purging, Suśr.
a: अनुलोमनं — 1 Regular gradation, sending or putting in the right direction. --2 (In medicine) Carrying off by the regular channels, such as purging; alleviation.

m: अनु-लोम—परिणीता f. married in regular gradation.
अनुलोम-प्रतिलोम (said of a mythical sea and mountain), Divyāv.
अनु-लोमय Nom. P. अनु-लोमयति, to stroke or rub with the hair, Pāṇ. iii, 1, 25, Sch.; to send in the right direction or so as to carry off by the right channels, Suśr.
to make favourable, MBh.

a: अनुलोमयति — Den. P. 1 To stroke or rub with the hair or with the grain, go with the grain; तत्र प्रतिलोममनुलोमयेत् Suśr. --2 To evacuate, purge, carry off by the regular channels.

m: अनु-लोमिकी f. (with क्षान्ति) resignation to natural consequences, Sukh. i (cf. अन्-उत्पत्तिक-धर्म-क्षान्ति, and घोषानुगा, Dharmaś. 107).
अनु-√ लुभ् Caus. -लोभयति, to long for, desire, R.

a: अनुल्वण — a. 1 Not excessive, neither more nor less (अनतिरिक्त, अन्यूनाधिक); smoothed, free from disturbing circumstances (?). --2 Not clear or manifest.
